lines.trans: Marina, let's end this dangerous protest.
Let's go home from here right now.
Listen, Samsonov, you wanted to leave town.
This has long not been your city.
We came here to save you, after all.
I will not leave and will not abandon the students.
Brothers, calm down, these are just ordinary students.
They will soon freeze and leave on their own.
We will stand here until the very end.
A very serious fight will soon start here.
We must protect this historical wall.
Then we will stay near you.
